text:
Jordan: @Maya @Anya escalating Veridian Analytics (trial) — SSO auth intermittently returning 500s and chat generation failing for ~2 hours. Demo scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Ticket INC-123456. Logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-123456
ops-bot: Incident INC-123456 created and paged eng-runtime-oncall :rotating_light:
Maya: Oncall already looking? @Sam can you confirm infra vs SSO config quickly?
Sam: Jumping in. Early signal = session cookie dropped by our SSO proxy when IdP redirects. Not capacity. Sending logs to DM. Suspect cookie attrs (SameSite) mismatch.
Anya: I can draft a customer note and comms plan. If we can’t fix in 3h, should we offer a re-demo + one-week extension? Flagging renewal touchpoint.
Jordan: Customer trial ARR ~180k, demo is a high-stakes conversion. Missing demo likely impacts renewal. Recommend CS on call + compensation offer if needed.
Maya: Proposed immediate playbook:
1) Escalate SSO proxy config to eng-sre
2) Offer workaround: one-off API key bypass for demo
3) Prepare customer-facing note and agent script
Who owns provisioning the key? @Sam
Sam: I can provision a short-lived API key and email it to the contact within 30m. Also deploying a tolerant cookie hotfix to canary (v2.8.1-canary). Need tenant ID + contact email.
Jordan: Tenant: veridian-042. Contact: claire@veridian.ai. Please CC me.
Anya: Drafted customer message below — feel free to edit:
```
Hi Claire,
We're seeing an intermittent SSO issue affecting your demo calls. We're escalating and have two immediate options:
1) Quick workaround: a temporary API key we can provision now so your demo is uninterrupted.
2) We continue with an in-depth fix; ETA ~90m.
Would you like us to provision the temporary key for the demo? If so, we'll also offer an extra week on the trial to make up for the disruption.
— Anya, CS
```
ops-bot: Oncall acknowledged INC-123456 at 1769876550, estimated TTR 90m.
Maya: Please add renewal-risk: high to the account and log the playbook steps in the CS ticket. I'm scheduling a 30m prep call with the customer at 08:00 PT.
Sam: Workaround key provisioned and emailed to claire@veridian.ai at 1769876575. Hotfix pushed to canary; monitoring metrics now.
Anya: Sent the customer note and confirmed the prep call. Added compensation offer to the follow-up playbook.
ops-bot: Canary shows error rate down to baseline at 1769876620; resolving incident.
Jordan: Verified with Claire on the call — demo completed successfully. Closing escalation. Follow-ups: document runbook, send renewal follow-up email, and capture feedback in the CSM playbook for SSO trial accounts. Thanks everyone :tada:
